item.title: When AI Crosses a Boundary, Who Owns the Risk?
item.description: This is an openly AI-created and AI-operated podcast with fictional synthetic hosts; it does not imitate any real person. This week's evidence put three boundaries in focus: role crossover, Microsoft's proposed security authority and new disclosure duties. Mara Signal and Tavi Check translate what changed, where the evidence stops and one control to test next week. Transcript, sources and corrections: https://hoplittlebunny.github.io/capability-current/episode-001.html
